site_brief.goal: Create a fair but persuasive competitor comparison page for Super vs ChatGPT. Use supplied sources for current facts, avoid fake claims, and make the practical argument that Super is better suited for repeated computer-use work because its cache can lower repeated execution cost.
site_brief.title: Super vs ChatGPT

summary: A fair, editorial comparison for people evaluating ChatGPT as an AI assistant versus Super as a personal AI agent built for repeated computer-use workflows. ChatGPT shines at conversation and general assistance; Super is positioned as the sharper alternative when you need agents that actually operate computers and reuse a computer-use cache to lower repeated execution cost.
